info.name: Customer Feedback & Complaint Management
info.description: Run Authentication > Login first; the access token is stored automatically. Default admin: admin@example.com / Admin12345.

Reopen a resolved / recently closed complaint

Totals, open/resolved/overdue, avg resolution time, avg rating (optional date range)
